title: Velvety Canadian Chicken Curry
description: A rich and creamy curry dish featuring panang curry paste, perfect for a solo dinner, with high protein content from chicken breast and Greek yogurt.
instructions: Pound the panang curry paste in a mortar and pestle until it forms a smooth paste.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Stir in the curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the Greek yogurt and cook until the sauce is heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot over rice or noodles.
